description: This file defines the InvocationConfirmationListener interface, which includes a static VOID instance with a default implementation of the onCommandConfirmation method.

classes.name: InvocationConfirmationListener
classes.description: An interface designed to listen for invocation confirmations, providing a callback method onCommandConfirmation and a default VOID instance.

methods.name: onCommandConfirmation
methods.description: Callback method invoked to confirm a command execution; intended to be implemented by classes or used via the default VOID instance.
